story: The Forest of Nisene Marks State Park is located in California, United States, protecting a secondary forest across 10,223 acres of variable terrain. Four-fifths of the park is covered in dense redwood forest, rising from sea level to steep coastal mountains of more than 2,600 feet.
matters: The park protects a secondary forest in the watershed of Aptos Creek and Soquel Creek within the Santa Cruz Mountains, featuring an ancient grove of redwood trees.
name: The Forest of Nisene Marks State Park
